community.label: Community & rewards
community.note: Module-derived address people_community_genesis; replace via governance before mainnet if a multisig is required.

validators.label: Validators & staking pool
validators.note: Validator reward pool (200M PPL). M11-2 (owner-approved): each year's 60M/50M/50M/40M PPL tranche is laid out as ~365 daily PeriodicVestingAccount periods, not one yearly cliff; every block, StreamValidatorPool (chain/overrides/evmd/peoplefees) drains whatever the SDK's native vesting lock has already unlocked and pays it to whichever validators signed the previous block, in addition to the 30% live fee share.

team.label: Team & founders
team.note: A11 (owner decision): 0% unlocked at mainnet genesis, 6-month cliff, then 18 months linear (ContinuousVestingAccount with original_vesting = 100% of the bucket, start_time = genesis + 6 months, end_time = genesis + 24 months; nothing is spendable before the cliff and the vested amount grows linearly from 0 after it). The schedule is fixed in genesis: no message can change a vesting account's schedule. Owner must still supply the real team-controller key for this address before mainnet; the schedule above does not by itself fix custody.

treasury.label: Ecosystem treasury (DAO)
treasury.note: A11 (owner decision): same schedule as team, 0% at genesis, 6-month cliff, then 18 months linear. The 2-of-3 treasury_multisig below is a ContinuousVestingAccount whose original_vesting and genesis balance are this whole bucket (the liquidity bucket no longer shares the address: it sits in the genesis liquidity vault, see liquidity_vault). Spendable only by the 2-of-3 treasury_multisig below (owner, co-founder, owner's cold address). An existing network upgrading from the old people_treasury module account sweeps its balance here via the v2-treasury-multisig gov software-upgrade (see chain/overrides/evmd/upgrades). Path to on-chain governance: the multisig can later transfer custody to x/gov (e.g. by moving funds to the community pool) via a further coordinated upgrade.

sale.label: Community sale
sale.note: Owner must set sale/vesting controller before public sale.

liquidity.label: Liquidity
liquidity.note: Owner decision (PR #72, open question 6): genesis liquidity is not spendable. The bucket is the bank balance of a keyless address (last 20 bytes of keccak256("PEOPLE genesis liquidity vault"), no private key exists) that holds GenesisLiquidityVault runtime code (chain/emission/genesis-liquidity-vault.json) set in genesis evm.accounts. Its only exit is seed(): wrap to WPPL, add to the WPPL/quote pool at or above the price floor, LP minted straight into a new LiquidityLock (730 days, immutable). No owner, setter, withdraw, receive/fallback, delegatecall or selfdestruct; parameters are fixed in genesis storage (see liquidity_vault).

liquidity_vault.note: GenesisLiquidityVault storage slots 0..5, written into genesis and immutable afterwards. wppl/factory: the WPPL and PeopleAmmFactory addresses on the PEOPLE network (predicted CREATE addresses of the deployer's first transactions, or genesis-embedded contracts); quote_token: the bridged stablecoin; beneficiary: EVM address (e.g. a Safe) that receives the LP from each LiquidityLock after 730 days; seeder: the only EVM caller of seed(), brings the quote tokens; min_quote_per_ppl: price floor in quote base units per 1 PPL (1e18 aPPL). Any zero (the current placeholders) or a wrong address keeps the liquidity sealed forever: fail-safe, never spendable. Owner must set real values before mainnet genesis.

treasury_multisig.note: TESTNET ONLY. The 2-of-3 native multisig (test-signer1, test-signer2, test-signer3; threshold 2) that was created and exercised on testnet on 2026-10-08 (docs/TREASURY-MULTISIG-RU.md: funding + a 2-of-3 signed bank send). Its keys are eth_secp256k1 test keys held in the testnet VPS keyring, so it is still NOT mainnet custody: before mainnet genesis the owner must regenerate it from three independently-held keys (owner, co-founder, owner's cold address) and update this block plus TreasuryMultisigAddress in chain/overrides/evmd/peoplefees/feesplit.go together. Replaces the earlier published-seed placeholder people1prcc866w0qye2nw3sqvt3ufxaarfqzrgknqeju.

mainnet_prep.note: M11-5/M10-5 (owner-approved): chain/scripts/build-peopled.sh patches upstream testnet.go so the 4 well-known example mnemonics are funded only when TESTNET_SEED_WELL_KNOWN_ACCOUNTS=1 (default: not funded), and default validator commission is 10% (was 100%, upstream-example-only). Bootstrap address in genesis is the people-node (JS chain) fix in apps/node/src/node-service.ts — unrelated binary, tracked here because the task bundles both chains' mainnet-prep items.

distribution.comment: Must stay 0 while Model A is enforced in peoplefees (25% community). Non-zero community_tax would re-split any fee-collector dust and double-count the community share.

fee_sink_modules.comment: M11-2 (owner-approved): RouteModelAFees sends all three shares straight to treasury_multisig.address, not to these module accounts. Names kept for the one-time upgrade-handler sweep of balances a pre-M11-2 network already accumulated in them.

genesis_extra_accounts.comment: Testnet genesis v2 (2026-10-08, owner-approved fresh genesis): liquid testnet accounts carved out of the community bucket, so total supply stays 1B PPL. Faucet = the EVM faucet key (FAUCET_PRIVATE_KEY on the VPS); deployers fund the EVM contract deploy/seed. The 4 well-known/public test accounts of the previous genesis are not included (M11-5).

accounts.label: deployer v2 (orchestrator key, testnet genesis v2)
